capabilities: Open a quick-capture modal via a global OS hotkey or obsidian://quick-capture URI
Search the vault by note title and navigate to the matching note
Create a new note with a title and body content
Submit new notes with Ctrl+Enter or a Submit button
extras: Several listed features are unchecked in the README's task list (datalist filtering while typing, duplicate-name notices), so they are not yet implemented; a 'Conversation' section at the end is empty. Global hotkey setup requires an external tool per OS.
problem: Obsidian's switcher and note creation only work inside the app, so capturing a note from anywhere in the OS requires switching to Obsidian first and needs an external hotkey tool to trigger.

relations.evidence: You can use a tool like AutoHotkey to set up a global hotkey.
